verses.text_en:
Believe, ye righteous, that the sinners will become a shame,
And perish in the day of unrighteousness.
verses.text_hr: Vjerujte, pravednici, da će grešnici postati sramota i propasti u dan nepravde.

verses.text_en:
Be it known unto you (ye sinners) that the Most High is mindful of your destruction,
And the angels of heaven rejoice over your destruction.
verses.text_hr: Neka vam bude poznato, grešnici, da Svevišnji pamti vašu propast, a nebeski se anđeli raduju vašoj propasti.

verses.text_en:
What will ye do, ye sinners,
And whither will ye flee on that day of judgement,
When ye hear the voice of the prayer of the righteous?
verses.text_hr: Što ćete učiniti, vi grešnici, i kamo ćete pobjeći na onaj sudnji dan, Kada čujete glas molitve pravednika?

verses.text_en:
Yea, ye shall fare like unto them,
Against whom this word shall be a testimony:
“Ye have been companions of sinners.”
verses.text_hr: Da, bit ćete poput onih protiv kojih će ova riječ svjedočiti: ‘Bili ste drugovi grešnika.’

verses.text_en:
And in those days the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto the Lord.
And for you the days of your judgement shall come,
verses.text_hr: I u one će dane molitva pravednika stići do Gospodina. I za vas će doći dani vašeg suda,
I sve riječi vaše nepravednosti bit će pročitane pred Velikim Svetim; i vaša će lica biti prekrivena sramotom, i On će odbaciti svako djelo koje je utemeljeno na nepravdi.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid-ocean and on the dry land,
Whose remembrance is evil against you.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, grešnici koji živite usred oceana i na kopnu, jer je spomen na vas zao.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness, and say:
“We have become rich with riches and have possessions,
And have acquired everything we have desired.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji nepravedno stječete srebro i zlato i govorite: ‘Obogatili smo se, imamo posjede i stekli smo sve što smo željeli.

verses.text_en:
And now let us do what we purposed:
For we have gathered silver,
9^d And many are the husbandmen in our houses,
9^c And our granaries are (brim)full as with water.”
verses.text_hr: A sada učinimo što smo naumili, jer smo nakupili srebro; 9^d mnogo je ratara u našim kućama, 9^c a žitnice su nam pune do vrha kao vodom.’
Da, vaše će laži oteći poput vode. Vaše bogatstvo neće opstati, nego će brzo otići od vas, jer ste sve stekli u nepravdi i bit ćete predani velikom prokletstvu.
